title.zh: 在北达沃省第二立法区设立区工程办公室并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Creating a District Engineering Office in the Second Legislative District of the Province of Davao Del Norte, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Creating a District Engineering Office in the Second Legislative District of the Province of Davao Del Norte, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2024/ra_12014_2024.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: A district engineering office of the Department of Public Works and Highways is hereby created in the Second Legislative District, Province of Davao del Norte, to be located in the Municipality of Carmen, and referred to as the Davao del Norte Second District Engineering Office.

The Davao del Norte Second District Engineering Office shall serve the City of Panabo, the Island Garden City of Samal and the municipalities of B.E. Dujali, Carmen and Santo Tomas, all located in the Second Legislative District of the Province of Davao del Norte.

The Secretary of Public Works and Highways shall include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Davao del Norte Second District Engineering Office, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following its publication in the Official Gazette or in a national newspaper of general circulation.
